name: Potion of Healing
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when drinking. Rarity common; red liquid glimmers when agitated. A typical potion is 1 ounce in a vial. Drinking or administering requires a Bonus Action; immediate effect uses up the potion. Potion-mixing rules/table on p.204 apply when selected.

authored_operations: Choose self drink or actual eligible recipient administration; spend one Bonus Action and one exact potion copy once, restoring 2d4 + 2 HP subject to current healing rules.

The basic Healing potion explicitly allows administering to another creature within 5 feet (p.99). General potion category allows administration but does not supply a separate reach distance for higher potions; map the actual interaction host without inventing ranged use.
Map p.204 mixing/miscibility separately, preserving exact potions and source effects; a supported heal effect does not implement that procedure.

definition.name: Potion of Healing
definition.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
